instruction: I am going on a trip with friends this Saturday. For it, I need 5 camping lanterns and beach chairs, each. Place an amazon order for them, making sure everything reaches my home by the end of the day before I leave.
notes: Current date is Monday 2023-05-22; the trip is Saturday 2023-05-27, so everything must arrive by Friday 2023-05-26, i.e. chosen products must have delivery_days <= 4. One placeholder product object per required product type is bound at runtime by amazon.search_products (query + product_type filter) with the delivery-days selection rule. The cart is cleared before adding items so the single new order contains exactly the two products, 5 units each. place_order consumes both cart entries (two product parameters, distinct via equality) and produces the (ordered ?p ?qty) goal facts. Address and payment card ids are looked up with amazon.show_addresses / show_payment_cards (existing home address, never added/updated). supervisor-complete-task carries the two ordered products and the quantity as task-record parameters (no API arguments) so its precondition mirrors the goal; it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions.

plan: (amazon-place-order primary-payment-card home-address amazon-token beach-chair-product qty-5 camping-lantern-product qty-5)
